User story: Affects: API-04 API-08

Errors found: Both run routes declared conn: Store and blobs: Blobs and derived the actor in the route body. Fix applied: Identity is a declared dependency, actor_from_request, declared ahead of Store and Blobs on both routes; FastAPI builds a route's dependency list in parameter order and solves it sequentially. User story: Affects: DLV-03 DLV-04 DLV-05 BND-01
Expected behaviour (from code): A revision id reaching pinned state, a publication row or a governed audit payload carries BoundaryText: NFC-normalised before the length bound, and refused for a lone surrogate, a Cc control other than CR/LF/TAB, or a bidirectional override or isolate.
Code reference: server/deliverable/filing.py sign_opinion, freeze, file_deliverable, Opinion, Receipt, _signatures, _frozen
How tested: named tests in tests/test_deliverable.py against a real Postgres
Baseline result: FAIL (found reading CLAUDE.md's boundary-text rule against the filing chain)
Errors found: All three functions took revision_id as a bare str and wrote it into deliverable_opinions, deliverable_publications and three governed audit payloads. The composed and decomposed spellings of one accented label render identically and differ in byte string, so they were two revisions: the decomposed spelling found no signature at all (DELIVERABLE_NOT_SIGNED), and signed under it the case would hold a publication row each for one label -- 'a revision is frozen once' holding per byte string rather than per label somebody approved. A label carrying U+202E reached the store unrefused, so the revision a reviewer reads on screen and the revision the store holds could differ.
Fix applied: revision_id is BoundaryText on all three functions, on Opinion and Receipt, and on _signatures and _frozen; .value is what reaches SQL, the three audit payloads and receipt_bytes. No refusal was added: DELIVERABLE_ALREADY_FROZEN already came off the conditional insert, and BOUNDARY_TEXT_INVALID is the type's own. Tests: test_a_revision_is_one_revision_however_its_label_is_normalised, test_a_revision_label_carrying_a_bidi_control_is_refused.
